This is how a digital clock would look if we used binary numbers to show time.
INTRODUCTIONM
When you needed to know the time, you would have to convert the binary number to decimal to see that it was 12:59.
This clock uses a binary decoder and a special display so you see the time represented in decimal numbers.
Let's begin the lesson on BINARY TO SEVEN SEGMENT CONVERSION................
LESSON MENU
The binary decoder circuit converts binary numbers to outputs that represent alphanumeric characters.
DISCUSSION
The outputs from the decoder are sent to a seven segment display.
The seven segment display uses seven light-emitting diodes arranged in a figure 8 pattern.
As the binary inputs to the decoder change the LEDs display the equivalent decimal number, 0 through 9...
Select a number to see its input and output.
Each LED segment is activated individually to produce the patterns necessary for decimal numbers.

Activating segments A,B,C,D, E and F produces the decimal number 0.
Activating all the segments produces the decimal number 8.
